headline: Penix's return revives Falcons' attack in rout of Packers
summary: In his first game since tearing his ACL last November, Michael Penix Jr. sparked the Falcons by passing for 256 yards with a touchdown in a 35-14 rout of the Packers at Lambeau Field.

headline: Thursday Night Football: Drake London, Bijan Robinson run by Packers 35-14
summary: London and Robinson combined for 407 yards and two touchdowns in Michael Penix's return to the lineup.

headline: LaFleur at a loss for answers to Packers' offensive woes
summary: The Packers are off to their worst start in coach Matt LaFleur's eight seasons after they were booed off Lambeau Field on Thursday night.

headline: Why are the Jaguars using CB/WR Travis Hunter sparingly?
summary: The highly anticipated two-way player is playing half of defensive snaps and has barely been seen on offense. But coach Liam Coen said it's by design.

headline: Texans face troubling trend when they play without Nico Collins
summary: Houston has seen a dip in scoring, and quarterback C.J. Stroud has seen his QBR decrease when targeting others.
